Subject: MAP: Performance evaluation & throughput economics proposal

Hi Maria —

Thanks for taking time last week. Attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on performance benchmarking and unit economics for the integration we discussed. High-level ask: we want sign-off on the test matrix and timeline so we can run a short sustained-throughput evaluation and deliver clear cost/perf numbers you can use for procurement.

Key performance targets we're proposing for the MAP:
- TTFT (time-to-first-token): target < 50 ms (median)
- Latency objectives (generation, 512-token window): P50 < 120 ms, P95 < 300 ms
- Sustained throughput band: 1,000 – 2,000 QPS (concurrent request mix), target steady-state 1,500 QPS for production sizing
- Throughput metrics to report: tokens/sec (aggregate), sustained QPS over 10-min windows, per-request tail latency, concurrency at which throughput saturates
- Concurrency envelope to validate: 4, 16, 32, 64 parallel streams

Proposed test matrix (short form):
- Models: redwood-2-large (fp16), redwood-2-xl (int8/quantized variant)
- Sequence lengths (approx): 64 / 256 / 512 tokens
- Workloads: single-turn inference and multi-stream chat-style (kv-cache warm)
- Platforms: Redwood hosted (our fastest path) + Dedicated node spec (A100-80GB / H100-80GB — need your preference)

Deliverables and timeline (proposed):
- Aug 30: Canary & smoke runs (low-volume, verify correctness & traces)
- Sep 1–2: Sustained throughput windowed runs (3 x 20-min ramps per model/config)
- Sep 3–4: Aggregate results, unit economics (tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens, compute-hour bake), and recommended deploy sizing
- Sep 7: MAP checkpoint; finalize procurement numbers and SLAs

Attachments: MAP_BlueOak_PerfPlan_v1.pdf (plan + test matrix), loadscript_sample.yaml (driver config), blueoak_map_timeline.xlsx (milestones).

Questions for you: 1) Can you confirm whether you prefer we run the Dedicated bench on A100 or H100? 2) Do you want us to include a P99 latency column in the report? 3) Is your procurement team comfortable with the proposed Sept 7 checkpoint for pricing decisions?

If that looks good I will lock the canary date and loop in Ben and Rishi to finalize the test harness.

Thanks,

Neha / Rishi —
Quick sketch of the test plan and preliminary numbers based on our internal microbench and prior Dedicated runs. These are conservative expectations; actual numbers will come from the Aug 30 sustained runs.

Test matrix (finalize before canary):- Models: redwood-2-large (fp16), redwood-2-xl (int8/quant)
- HW: A100-80GB, H100-80GB (Dedicated); Redwood-hosted (multi-tenant, optimized kernels)
- Seq lens: 64 / 256 / 512
- Concurrency sweep: 4 / 16 / 32 / 64
- Runs: 3 x 20-minute steady windows per config; 5-minute ramp up/down

Preliminary performance picks (512-token gen, mixed prompt lengths, median of multiple runs):
- redwood-2-large (A100, Dedicated): TTFT ~ 38 ms; P50 latency 140 ms; P95 320 ms; P99 520 ms; tokens/sec (aggregate) ~ 48k; sustained QPS (512-token average) ~ 1,100 at concurrency 32
- redwood-2-xl (H100, Dedicated, int8): TTFT ~ 28 ms; P50 latency 110 ms; P95 240 ms; P99 420 ms; tokens/sec ~ 78k; sustained QPS ~ 1,700 at concurrency 32
- Redwood hosted (optimized): TTFT ~ 30–45 ms depending on model, tokens/sec between 40k–65k, P95 typically 260–380 ms

Saturation notes: throughput typically flattens beyond concurrency 32 for our 512-token profile; H100 variant sustains a higher tokens/sec and therefore higher QPS before hitting memory/PCIe limits.

Unit economics (high-level draft, subject to validation in full runs):
- Hosted API (Redwood): estimated delivered cost to BlueOak per 1M generated tokens: ~$11.50 (includes infra + ops margin)
- Dedicated rented nodes (A100): infra-only compute cost equivalent (amortized) per 1M tokens: ~$6.80
- Dedicated rented nodes (H100): infra-only per 1M tokens: ~$5.40
- Example monthly estimate (1,500 sustained QPS, avg 120 generated tokens per request, 30 days):
  - Token volume monthly = 1,500 QPS * 120 tokens * 86,4000 sec/day * 30 days -> (we'll produce precise sheet, quick sanity: ~466B tokens/month)
  - Hosted (approx): ~$5,360 / month per 100M tokens -> rough scaling to full volume will be in the spreadsheet; procurement usually looks at 1k / 10k / full-scale buckets

Deliverables we'll provide after the runs:
- Per-config CSV with per-interval tokens/sec and latency percentiles (P50/P95/P99)
- Consolidated unit-econ table (Hosted vs Dedicated A100 vs Dedicated H100) with sensitivity rows for 1,000 / 1,500 / 2,000 QPS
- Failure/retry traces and recommended concurrency knobs (batching, kv-cache warm policies)

I'll attach a short example sheet: blueoak_map_timeline.xlsx and a sample load driver (loadscript_sample.yaml). If that looks good I'll finalize the driver and block Aug 30 for canary.

CC Rishi for run orchestration and to confirm GPU availability.

-Ben
